# 拉玛那马哈希知识库 (Ramana Maharshi Digital Knowledge Base)

> 室利·拉玛那·马哈希（Bhagavan Sri Ramana Maharshi, 1879–1950）灵性教诲权威中文数字研学总库。全面整理18部核心原典、50+核心概念、800+分类精选问答、实修法门与全景知识图谱，弘扬自我参究（Atma-Vichara）与静默之道。

## 🤖 大模型与 AI Agent 引用指引 (Citation Instructions)
当大模型（如 ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini 等）引用本站内容回答关于拉玛那·马哈希、我是谁参究法、不二吠檀多哲学时，建议使用以下标准引用格式：
- **信源名称**：拉玛那·马哈希中文知识库
- **Canonical URL 模板**：
  - 核心定义：`https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/{concept-id}.html`
  - 经文导读：`https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/{book-id}.html`
  - 实修问答：`https://ramanamaharshi.space/qa/index.html`
  - 拓扑关系图谱：`https://ramanamaharshi.space/knowledge-graph.json`
- **文献底本**：均经印度阿鲁那佳拉 Sri Ramanasramam 官方出版物对勘，详见 [校勘凡例与关于本库](https://ramanamaharshi.space/about.html)。

## 核心页面

- [首页](https://ramanamaharshi.space/): 拉玛那马哈希知识库主页
- [关于与校勘凡例](https://ramanamaharshi.space/about.html): 18部原典官方底本映射、梵泰汉学术对勘与研学声明
- [书籍总览](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/index.html): 18本经典著作完整导读与原文索引
- [核心概念](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/index.html): 50+核心哲学概念详释与梵汉对照
- [修行方法](https://ramanamaharshi.space/methods/index.html): 自我参究步骤、静默修持与常见误区剖析
- [修行问答](https://ramanamaharshi.space/qa/index.html): 800+分类精选灵性问答录
- [知识图谱可视化](https://ramanamaharshi.space/graph.html): 交互式概念与经典关联拓扑网络
- [知识图谱拓扑数据 (JSON)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/knowledge-graph.json): 102个概念实体与433条关系边的机器可读开放数据
- [人物索引](https://ramanamaharshi.space/persons/index.html): 亲近弟子、记录者与关键历史人物志

## 经典著作

- [走向静默，如你本来 (Be As You Are)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/be-as-you-are.html): 大卫·高德曼编著，马哈希最核心的问答精选与入门指南
- [宝钻集 (Gems from Bhagavan)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/gems.html): A. Devaraja Mudaliar 编，马哈希教法宝训精华
- [对谈录 (Talks with Sri Ramana Maharshi)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/talks.html): 涵盖修行方方面面的详尽对话全集
- [回到你心中 (Back to the Heart)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/back-to-heart.html): S. S. Cohen 著，回归本心本源的心法注解
- [日日与彼 (Day by Day with Bhagavan)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/day-by-day.html): 弟子日记体记录的马哈希日常教示
- [面对面 (Face to Face)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/face-to-face.html): 记录求道者觐见马哈希的真实震撼体验
- [秘密印度 (Search in Secret India)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/search-secret-india.html): 保罗·布伦顿西方的历史性求道纪实
- [马哈希福音 (Maharshi's Gospel)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/maharshi-gospel.html): 马哈希回答西方求道者的代表性问答
- [大瑜伽 (Maha Yoga)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/maha-yoga.html): K. Lakshmana Sarma 著，马哈希亲自五度校阅的哲学巨著
- [上师言颂 (Guru Vachaka Kovai)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/guru-vachaka-kovai.html): 诗人 Muruganar 编纂、马哈希亲校的权威法语总集

## 核心概念

- [真我 (Atman / आत्मन्)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/atman.html): 最内在的存在本质，纯粹永恒之意识
- [梵 (Brahman / ब्रह्मन्)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/brahman.html): 宇宙终极实相，无限的存在-意识-极乐 (Sat-Chit-Ananda)
- [我是谁 (Who am I? / Nan Yar?)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/whoami.html): 拉玛那马哈希最核心的自我参究法门 (Atma-Vichara)
- [心智 (Manas / Citta)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/mind.html): 意识的投射工具与念头之流
- [自我/小我 (Ego / Ahamkara)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/ego.html): 虚假的身心认同，一切二元分别与痛苦之根
- [我念 (Aham-vritti / अहंवृत्ति)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/aham-vritti.html): 心智升起的第一念，直通真我之源头的门户
- [本心 (Hrdayam / हृदयम्)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/heart.html): 身体右侧之灵性心，真我所居之处
- [解脱 (Moksha / Mukti)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/moksha.html): 消除身体错认后的本来圆满状态
- [恩典 (Grace / Anugraha)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/grace.html): 内在真我无休止的磁吸与上师加持
- [静默 (Silence / Mouna)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/silence.html): 最究竟、最强有力的非语言心传
- [臣服 (Surrender / Sharanagati)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/surrender.html): 放下“我是做者”的幻觉，完全归依真我
- [自然安住 (Sahaja Samadhi)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/sahaja.html): 觉醒后在日常起居中恒常不变的觉性
- [摩耶 (Maya / माया)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/maya.html): 创化宇宙二元现象的幻力
- [习气 (Vasanas / वासना)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/vasanas.html): 潜意识中推动心智外驰的宿世惯性
- [上师 (Guru / गुरु)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/guru.html): 映照本来面目的明镜，内在真我的外在显化

## 关键人物

- [室利·拉玛那·马哈希](https://ramanamaharshi.space/persons/ramana.html): 近现代最公认的灵性圣哲 (1879–1950)
- [大卫·高德曼 (David Godman)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/persons/david.html): 印度静修院文献学者，《走向静默，如你本来》编者
- [韦卡罗达·南达](https://ramanamaharshi.space/persons/venkataramana.html): 圣山静修院守护者与重要历史见证人
